name: Chewtoy
source:
Local summoner bites off more than she can chew.

"A spell wraps from another world, wraps itself around my neck and pulls"

"It's weak, the only thing that prevents me from tearing it apart is curiosity."

"I want to know exactly which idiot in the mundane world is stupid enough to try summoning a hell hound."

[From [url=https://ladysatya.itch.io/chewtoy]itch.io[/url]]
